Taxes are added to invoice lines.

## Steps

::::::steps
::::step{title="Open Settings › Taxes"}
Select **Settings**, then **Taxes**, then **New tax**.

![The tax list](images/taxes-list.webp)

:::legend
1. **New tax** opens the form.
:::
::::

::::step{title="Name the tax and set its rate"}
Enter the **Tax Name**, **Tax Code** and **Rate**.
::::

::::step{title="Choose the account"}
Choose the **Account** the tax posts to. If the tax is withheld at source, also choose the **Withholding Receivable Account**.
::::

::::step{title="Save"}
Select **Save**. The tax can now be picked on invoice lines.
::::
::::::

## If something goes wrong

| Message | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| Rate must be between 0 and 100 | Enter a percentage from 0 to 100, for example 7.5. |
| A withholding receivable account is required when tax is withheld at source | Choose a **Withholding Receivable Account**. |
